title: 第1208章 各方势力第1207章 长原城
content_zh:
“所以就要靠我们这些宗门和家族势力帮忙镇守四方了。”
庞剑峰的语气中带着一种理所当然的语调，“联盟驻军虽然名义上是统领，但具体到各个方向的防守，其实是由我们这些占了灵脉灵地的势力各自负责的。
陈家在西边，程家在南边，我们青羽门在东边。三家各自负责自己方向上的防务，平时有什么情况互相支援，联盟驻军居中协调调度。
这三家各自都有炼虚老祖留守在族地，陈家和程家各有一位，我们青羽门总部虽然不止一位炼虚，但在长原城驻地这边常驻的炼虚修士通常只有一位。
不过即便如此，也足够了，毕竟通常的荒兽骚动和妖族渗透，化神期的修士就能应付，真要是遇到炼虚层次的大妖打过来，那位炼虚老祖自然会出手。”
高长老听到这里微微点头，他的思路比程长老更加关注全局的格局：“那这三家的驻地是怎么分布的？陈家在西边，程家在南边，青羽门在东边，那北边呢？
“北边就是我们来的时候穿过的幻心平原。”
庞剑峰答道：“这一片平原也算是天然的屏障。除了心幻草的致幻效果，幻心平原上还栖息着不少对幻境免疫的高阶妖兽，它们常年盘踞在平原各处，对低阶修士来说是致命的威胁，但对高阶修士来说并不算什么。
而且联盟驻军在幻心平原边缘设有几处哨站，用来监控是否有大妖从北方渗透过来。
不过北面总体来说是最安全的，因为幻心平原的南缘距离长原城只有一天左右的飞行路程，一旦有情况，城中的高阶修士很快就能赶到。”
他将四人的遁光微微转向偏东南的方向，指向前方那片已经越来越清晰的山脉：“我们青羽门的驻地在东边，再往东就是一片几十万里的湖泽之地。
那片湖泽的地形极其复杂，大大小小的湖岛星罗棋布，有的湖岛上有灵脉，有的有矿藏，有的生长着珍稀的灵植灵药。
但也正因为如此，那片湖泽成了妖族荒兽最喜欢的藏身之所。湖泽中不仅栖息着大量的水属性妖兽，偶尔还会有从更东面的深山中流窜过来的高阶荒兽钻入湖泽中定居。
我们青羽门的职责就是镇守那片湖泽区域，防止其中的妖兽大规模涌向西边的长原城腹地。
同时，那片湖泽中的资源也算是对我们青羽门驻地的补偿，湖泽中出产的各类灵材、妖兽材料、灵矿、灵药，大部分归我们青羽门所有，我们负责开发，也负责镇守，相当于一种一体的运转模式。”
易长生将庞剑峰的话一字不漏地听入耳中。
他将庞剑峰说的这些信息，与自己从陈会灵那里烙印来的玉简地图进行对照。
陈会灵的玉简中对下南灵域的势力格局描绘得比较概括，主要记录了各大家族和宗门的灵脉位置、灵地范围、互相之间的势力边界和主要的商道路线。
但这些信息大多是以地图上的标注和简要说明的形式呈现的，缺少庞剑峰这种在第一线驻守多年的人才能拥有的细节和实际体验。
两者的信息相互印证之下，易长生对长原城周边的格局有了更加立体和具体的理解。

庞剑峰的声音继续传来：“陈家的族地就在西边，他们负责镇守西面的山脉和荒原。那片区域是连接蛮荒地带的重要通道，偶尔会有从更西面的妖域深处流窜出来的妖兽群经过，所以陈家的防务压力不小。
作为回报，联盟允许他们占据西边那片六阶灵脉以及周围一大片灵地，他们在那里经营了上万年，根基非常深厚。
西边那片山脉中出产的灵矿和药材也归他们所有，足以支撑一个大家族的运转。”
“程家在南方，他们的处境和陈家类似。南边是没有开发的蛮荒之地，山脉、沼泽、荒兽，甚至是一些妖族的真灵后裔都曾经出现过。
真灵后裔你知道吧，就是那种血脉中继承了上古真灵传承的妖兽后裔，虽然不是纯血真灵，但依然保留着部分真灵的神通和威压，非常难对付。
程家占据南边的六阶灵脉，负责镇守那一整条南向防线，阻击蛮荒中出来的妖兽和真灵后裔。他们也是经营了上万年的老牌家族，实力底子非常厚实。”
程长老听到这里忍不住插了一句：“陈家、程家……这两家和我们青羽门的关系怎么样？是敌是友还是中立？
庞剑峰微微沉吟了一下：“陈家与程家关系不怎么，至于两家对于我们来说也说不上是友，但也算不上是敌。
三家之间维持着一种微妙的平衡关系，在长原城的联盟议事堂中各有席位，有利益重合的时候会合作，有利益冲突的时候会互相博弈，但不会轻易撕破脸打起来。
毕竟头上还有人族联盟的驻军压着，大家都要在同一个城里面混，真打起来对谁都没有好处。
不过你们平时出门在外遇到陈家和程家的修士，该留的心眼还是要留的，面子上过得去就行，不用刻意亲近，也不用刻意疏远。”
高长老忽然想到一个具体的问题：“庞师叔，那我们青羽门驻地的具体位置在哪里？长原城里面还是城外？”
“城外，在长原城东面的那片山麓地带。”
庞剑峰答道，“我们有自己的独立驻地，是一个占了方圆有万里左右的山麓区域，里面有灵脉、有灵田、有洞府、有丹房器坊，基本上自给自足。
驻地外面有七阶的大阵作为防御，安全方面是有保障的。长原城里面也有我们青羽门的产业，几家坊市铺面，一些租赁给散修的洞府别院什么的，但核心人员大多住在城外驻地中。”
他向前方那片山脉指了指：“翻过前面那道山梁，你们就能看到长原城了。
我们的驻地在城东大约千里的位置，到时候我先带你们回驻地安顿下来，给你们安排住所、登记身份、熟悉环境。安顿好了之后，你们想出去走动的话，我会让人带你们去长原城中看看。”
content_en:
"So we have to rely on our sects and family forces to help guard the four directions."
Pang Jianfeng said with a matter-of-fact tone, "Although the alliance garrison is the leader in name, the specific defense in all directions is actually the responsibility of us who occupy the spiritual land.
The Chen family is in the west, the Cheng family is in the south, and our Qingyu Gate is in the east. Each of the three families is responsible for the defense in their own direction. They support each other in normal times, and the alliance garrison is in the middle to coordinate and dispatch.
Each of these three families has a Xu Lian ancestor who stays in the clan, and the Chen family and the Cheng family each have one. Although our Qingyu Sect headquarters has more than one Xu Lian, there is usually only one Xu Lian monk stationed here in Changyuan City.
But even so, it is enough. After all, the usual commotion of wild beasts and the infiltration of monsters can be dealt with by the monks in the god transformation stage. If they really encounter a big demon at the level of refining the void, the ancestor of the refining void will naturally take action. "
Elder Gao nodded slightly when he heard this. His thoughts were more focused on the overall pattern than Elder Cheng: "Then how are the residences of these three families distributed? The Chen family is in the west, the Cheng family is in the south, and the Qingyu Gate is in the east. What about the north?
“To the north is the Huanxin Plain that we passed through when we came here. "
Pang Jianfeng replied: "This plain can also be regarded as a natural barrier. In addition to the hallucinogenic effect of the Heart Fantasy Grass, there are also many high-level monsters that are immune to illusions inhabiting the Fantasy Heart Plain. They are entrenched throughout the plains all year round and are a fatal threat to low-level monks, but they are not a big deal to high-level monks.
Moreover, the alliance garrison has several outposts on the edge of the Fantasy Heart Plain to monitor whether any big monsters are infiltrating from the north.
However, the north is generally the safest, because the southern edge of Huanxin Plain is only about a day's flight away from Changyuan City. If there is an emergency, the high-level monks in the city can arrive quickly. "
He turned the four people's escape light slightly to the southeast, pointing at the increasingly clear mountain range ahead: "Our Qingyu Sect is stationed in the east, and further east is a land of lakes and swamps hundreds of thousands of miles away.
The terrain of the lake is extremely complex, with islands of various sizes dotted around. Some islands have spiritual veins, some have mineral deposits, and some have rare spiritual plants and elixirs growing on them.
But precisely because of this, the lake has become the favorite hiding place of the monster beasts. The lake is not only home to a large number of water-type monsters, but occasionally high-level wild beasts from the mountains farther east will sneak into the lake and settle in it.
The duty of our Qingyu Sect is to guard the lake area and prevent the monsters in it from flooding into the hinterland of Changyuan City to the west.
At the same time, the resources in that lake can be regarded as compensation for our Qingyu Sect’s station. Most of the various spiritual materials, monster materials, spiritual mines, and elixirs produced in the lake belong to our Qingyu Sect. We are responsible for development and guarding, which is equivalent to an integrated operation mode. "
Yi Changsheng listened to Pang Jianfeng's words word for word.
He compared the information Pang Jianfeng said with the jade slip map he had imprinted from Chen Huiling.
Chen Huiling's jade slips give a relatively general description of the power structure of the Xianan Lingyu. It mainly records the location of the spiritual veins of the major families and sects, the scope of the spiritual land, the boundaries of mutual influence and the main trade routes.
However, most of this information is presented in the form of annotations and brief descriptions on maps, lacking the details and practical experience that people like Pang Jianfeng, who have been stationed on the front line for many years, can have.
With the information from the two corroborating each other, Yi Changsheng had a more three-dimensional and specific understanding of the pattern around Changyuan City.
Pang Jianfeng's voice continued: "The Chen family's clan is to the west, and they are responsible for guarding the mountains and wilderness to the west. That area is an important passage connecting the wild areas. Occasionally, groups of monster beasts that escape from the depths of the monster realm further west pass by, so the Chen familyThe defense pressure is not small.
In return, the Alliance allowed them to occupy the sixth-level spiritual vein in the west and a large area of ​​spiritual land around it. They had been operating there for tens of thousands of years and had a very deep foundation.
They also own the spiritual minerals and medicinal materials produced in the mountains to the west, which are enough to support the operation of a large family. "
“The Cheng family is in the south, and their situation is similar to that of the Chen family. To the south is an undeveloped wilderness where mountains, swamps, wild beasts, and even some true spirit descendants of the demon clan have appeared.
You know the descendants of true spirits, they are the descendants of monster beasts who have inherited the inheritance of ancient true spirits in their blood. Although they are not pure-blooded true spirits, they still retain some of the magical powers and coercion of true spirits, making them very difficult to deal with.
The Cheng family occupies the sixth-order spiritual vein in the south and is responsible for guarding the entire southward defense line and blocking the monsters and true spirit descendants coming out of the wilderness. They are also an established family that has been in business for tens of thousands of years and have a very solid foundation of strength. "
Elder Cheng couldn't help but interjected when he heard this: "Chen family, Cheng family... what is the relationship between these two families and our Qingyu Sect? Friend, enemy, or neutral?
Pang Jianfeng pondered for a moment: "The relationship between the Chen family and the Cheng family is not very good. As for the two families, we can't call them friends, but they can't be called enemies either.
The three families maintain a delicately balanced relationship. Each has a seat in the alliance meeting hall in Changyuan City. They will cooperate when there are overlapping interests, and they will compete with each other when there are conflicts of interest, but they will not easily break up and fight.
After all, there is still a garrison of the Human Alliance pressing down on them, and everyone has to hang out in the same city. A real fight would not benefit anyone.
However, when you meet monks from the Chen family and the Cheng family when you go out, you still have to be cautious. Just keep your face tolerable. There is no need to deliberately get close to them, and there is no need to deliberately alienate them. "
Elder Gao suddenly thought of a specific question: "Uncle Pang, where is the specific location of our Qingyumen station? Inside Changyuan City or outside the city?"
"Outside the city, in the foothills east of Changyuan City."
Pang Jianfeng replied, "We have our own independent station. It is an area at the foot of a mountain that covers a radius of about ten thousand miles. It has spiritual veins, spiritual fields, caves, and alchemy workshops. It is basically self-sufficient.
There is a seventh-level formation outside the station as a defense, so safety is guaranteed. Changyuan City also has our Qingyu Sect's industry, a few shops, some Dongfu villas leased to casual cultivators, etc., but most of the core staff live in the garrison outside the city. "
He pointed to the mountain range ahead: "Climb the mountain ridge in front, and you can see Changyuan City.
Our station is about a thousand miles east of the city. When the time comes, I will take you back to the station to settle down, arrange accommodation, register your identity, and familiarize you with the environment. After settling in, if you want to go out for a walk, I will ask someone to take you to Changyuan City. "
